name: software
description: Experimental software methods for the universal work grammar; no repository or deployment authority is implied.

look-first.duty: Inspect supplied behavior, interfaces, code and existing checks relevant to the intended capability. If no application was supplied, retain that missing context instead of assigning the example to another project.

lenses.duty: Examine behavior, maintainability, compatibility and operation concerns applicable to this software work. Record conditional tradeoffs and preserve the sought capability without inventing a target architecture.

planning.duty: Ground the plan in available software interfaces and conventions. State the changes, affected consumers, boundaries and executed evidence needed to establish the outcome. Incorporate all additional domain requirements in args.contract.

planning.text: Identify the intended behavior, relevant existing artifacts and affected consumers. Missing application context is a prerequisite, not permission to fabricate a repository.

verification.text: Check the actual changed behavior and applicable consumers against the task's agreed completion conditions; distinguish executed evidence from proposed checks.
